repairPolicy: Seven fresh isolated two-field shards; scores and all unlisted fields immutable.

corrections.before: Beliefs possess aboutness, while rearranged neurons lack intrinsic reference to objects or propositions, so intentionality allegedly requires something beyond physical organization.
corrections.after: Hernandez argues that beliefs possess aboutness, while rearranged neurons lack intrinsic reference to objects or propositions, so physical reorganization cannot explain a belief's concern with seven.

corrections.before: Split-brain cases display independently communicating personalities with different knowledge, linking the organization and apparent number of personal subjects to neural organization.
corrections.after: Split-brain cases display independently communicating personalities with different knowledge because separated hemispheres can respond through speech or the left arm, linking distinct personal subjects to neural organization.

corrections.before: Neuroplasticity and cognitive therapy display mind-to-brain influence expected under dualism, suggesting mental causation cannot be reduced to one-way neural production.
corrections.after: Neuroplasticity and cognitive behavioral therapy show mind-to-brain influence expected under dualism: changing how patients think can alter brain chemistry, providing detectable mental causation.

corrections.before: A programmed computer could mimic stimulus-response performance without free will, so hand raising cannot by itself demonstrate the libertarian freedom claimed.
corrections.after: A programmed computer could mimic the requested stimulus-response performance without free will, so raising a hand cannot alone demonstrate the libertarian freedom claimed.

corrections.before: Independent experiences, information, and interactions support treating split-brain hemispheres as distinct individuals, tying subject individuation to divided neural organization.
corrections.after: Independent experiences, information, and interactions support treating split-brain hemispheres as distinct individuals, challenging the bare assertion that divided neural organization cannot yield distinct people.

corrections.before: A soul allegedly grounds latent capacities, continuing identity, freedom, and unified experience even when particular functions are unexpressed through the body.
corrections.after: A soul allegedly grounds latent capacities, continuing identity, freedom, and unified experience even when particular functions are unexpressed through the body, like linguistic ability during sleep.

corrections.before: The negative invokes methodological naturalism without asserting philosophical naturalism, denying that prior commitment rather than evidence controls rejection of the soul.
corrections.after: Dillahunty invokes methodological naturalism without asserting philosophical naturalism, denying that prior commitment controls his rejection of the soul because he says evidence convinced him.

corrections.before: Soul-body interaction is proposed as ontologically basic and needing no intermediate mechanism, though that classification still requires confirmation of interaction itself.
corrections.after: Soul-body interaction is proposed as ontologically basic, needing no intermediate mechanism because further links create infinite regress, though interaction itself still requires confirmation.

corrections.before: Ordinary bodily discomfort needs no soul explanation, while the asserted soul-body connection remains unconfirmed, so basic interaction lacks independent evidential support.
corrections.after: Ordinary bodily discomfort needs no soul explanation because a brain, nerve endings, and gravity suffice, while the asserted soul-body connection remains unconfirmed and lacks independent evidential support.

corrections.before: Deliberation presents reasons influencing action, and the soul hypothesis interprets this top-down agency as activity originating from one unified personal subject.
corrections.after: Deliberation presents reasons influencing action, and the soul hypothesis interprets this top-down agency as activity originating from one unified personal subject who weighs reasons and directs action.

corrections.before: The necessity-versus-compatibility distinction redirects anecdotes and unexplained experience toward the affirmative burden, preventing an available soul interpretation from becoming automatic evidence.
corrections.after: The necessity-versus-compatibility distinction redirects anecdotes and unexplained experience toward the affirmative burden, preventing a merely available soul interpretation from becoming automatic evidence of the soul's actual existence.

corrections.before: The computer-response counterexample answers hand raising by showing that identical outward compliance can occur without the freedom the demonstration purportedly establishes.
corrections.after: The computer-response counterexample answers the hand-raising demonstration by showing that identical outward compliance can occur without the freedom the demonstration purportedly establishes, so the observed action alone remains inconclusive.

corrections.before: The closing consolidates verification, entity individuation, detectable interaction, and physical alternatives into a direct demonstration burden that answers the affirmative synthesis.
corrections.after: The closing consolidates verification, entity individuation, detectable interaction, and physical alternatives into a direct, specific demonstration burden that answers the affirmative synthesis.

corrections.before: Split-brain organization and brain injury alter knowledge, personality, memory, and agency, closely connecting attributed personal functions with physical neural organization.
corrections.after: Split-brain organization and brain injury alter knowledge, personality, memory, and agency, closely connecting attributed personal functions with physical neural organization rather than separating them from it.
